d: Niraj kumar ne patna snatak sit se emaelsi chunav men jit darj ki hai. anant sinh ke khas anuj sinh ko harane ke bad vo phayar mod men hai. aaj niraj kumar ne khulasa kiya ki unke pas jadyu ke tamam bare netaon ke phon aaen lekin lalan sinh ne unhen koee kol nahin kiya. niraj kumar ne ye bhi bataya ki vo khud bhi lalan sinh ko kol nahin karenge. jin netaon ne bhi chunav men unke khilaph kam kiya hai, unhen vo sabak sikhaenge. dekhiye ye riport
